Stop holding projects at a revision.

Removes spec.revision from the manifest of each named project, so the next slipway sync
fast-forwards its branch onto its upstream again. The repository is left as it is. A project without
spec.revision prints not pinned.

Usage: slipway rollout unpin [OPTIONS] (<NAME>... | project/<NAME>...)

Arguments:
  <NAME>...
          The name of a project.

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h').

Examples:
  # Let project hldr follow its upstream again
  slipway rollout unpin hldr

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
